## Description

Two wide V shaped chevrons stack vertically with matching diagonal arms. Both point downward around a shared centerline, leaving a broad open gap between the upper and lower marks.

## To author

Visual review at solo queue offset 110 confirmed this is an isolated double downward chevron, suitable for the sub family. Defer generation to `$icon-sub` on SUB32; preserve the source direction, simplicity and symmetry. This is one symbol, not a combination. Do not draw it as a standalone SOLO48 subject. Keep the original reference unchanged.
